bid_number: RFP 2026-070 U.S. Marketing Agency of Record
title: RFP - U.S. Marketing Agency of Record for LCVB

onscreen_lines.desc: • Ad Campaign o Strategic Planning - Analyze media outlet options to determine those most suitable and submit advertising buy recommendations to LCVB o Serve as liaison between the Laredo CVB and media representatives. o Secure advertising contracts on behalf of Laredo CVB for all ad buys o Place ads for billboard, print, radio, digital and TV ad buys; these to be paid directly by LCVB to the media outlet o Develop creative concepts to support cross-channel marketing efforts including: traditional, digital, social and experiential activations. • Graphic Design / Creative Services o Ad design o Ad resizing o Develop creative concepts to support cross-channel marketing efforts including: traditional, digital and social. o Develop all versions of artwork required in the media plan to complete a successful campaign implementation and its results. o Designs include: print publications, digital ads, billboards (both digital and static), e-newsletters, blogs, website, social media posts, online giveaway posts, trade show stands, trade show backdrops, rack cards, postcards, window decals, brochures, maps, etc. Design of different materials, and other elements to maintain brand consistency throughout our digital channels. o Edits and revisions to the design and copy of current collateral material including guides • Account Management o Preparation for presentations for select client meetings. o Review campaign and business metrics and make recommendations on how to best optimize and strategize as needed. o Incorporate analytics and metrics to allow for ongoing adjustments to the plan. o Prepare media estimates for client approval.

• Public Relations. o Proactively identify opportunities for media coverage and schedule interviews to generate positive press coverage of Laredo. o Develop messaging, draft news releases, monitor and report on story pitches and activities. o Pitch Laredo to industry news and websites. o Communications and press release writing. o Serve as liaison between Laredo and travel writers and influencers, securing contracts to be paid directly by LCVB and coordinate hosted visits. o Provide monthly reports summarizing media outreach efforts, including copies of pitches, secured interviews, published stories, and earned media coverage. o Provide a list of media outlets contacted by the agency.
